Bombay HC Directs Galli News on Defamation, Allows Medical Negligence Reporting

The Bombay High Court has issued a directive to Galli News, instructing its editor to remove content deemed prima facie defamatory against Habib Hospital. While the court has restrained defamatory imputations, it has allowed Galli News to continue reporting on alleged medical negligence concerning the hospital. This ruling balances the media's right to report on public interest matters with the need to prevent defamation.
